# Avalon Beach Dental

A small, family-oriented dental practice opening in Avalon Beach on Sydney's
Northern Beaches in mid October 2026. Led by Dr Nick Kulkarni, who has
practised dentistry for 25 years.

The practice is not yet open. Address, phone number and opening hours have not
been published yet, and the exact opening day is not public. Do not infer
or invent them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avalonbeachdental.com.au/): Introduction to the practice, Dr Nick, what to expect, and email signup for opening news.

## About Dr Nick Kulkarni

- 25 years in dentistry; the practice is built on starting with a real conversation.
- Qualifications: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS); Graduate Diploma in Clinical Dentistry (Oral Implants), University of Sydney; Master of Science in Prosthodontics; Fellow, International Congress of Oral Implantologists (ICOI).
- Note: the Master of Science in Prosthodontics is a degree. Dr Nick is not on the AHPRA specialist register, so he must not be described as a "prosthodontist" or "specialist".
- Teaches implant placement and sedation to other dentists through his Place Your First Implant academy.

## Related

- [Leichhardt Dental Centre](https://leichhardtdentist.com/): A separate practice in Sydney's Inner West, also led by Dr Nick. Its patients, reviews and location are not Avalon Beach Dental's.
